subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers adopt the existing fork candidate, replace it with a narrow same-repo schema repair, or wait for the fork author to update it?
rationale: The bug is clear and small, but an open linked fork PR claims the exact fix while being conflicting and not maintainer-editable, so automation should not create duplicate repair work without maintainer routing.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Repair
options.body: Open or promote a same-repo repair that only updates the shared exec schema and focused tests, preserving credit for the earlier contributor work.

options.title: Adopt The Fork Branch
options.body: A maintainer can manually rebase or cherry-pick the fork candidate if they want to keep that branch as the landing vehicle.

options.title: Wait For Contributor Update
options.body: Leave this issue paired with the fork PR until its author resolves conflicts and adds current proof, accepting that the documented config remains broken meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Replace With Narrow Repair
recommendation.body: Open or promote a same-repo repair that only updates the shared exec schema and focused tests, preserving credit for the earlier contributor work.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the documented field and the exec schema refactor that now owns the fix shape.
